en-US:
Internal test: Quick Log widgets and favourites.
• New Quick Log widget design in small, medium and a new large size: one main action, then labelled shortcuts. Glyphs are now − expense, + income, ⇄ transfer, ↩ refund.
• Large Budget status and Smart Overview widgets become Today + Log.
• Budget status shows a marker for today's place in the month.
• Favourites in Log: tap one to fill the form, then Save. Save any entry as a favourite with the star on the Saved banner.
• Settings › Widgets & Quick Access: previews, favourites, and privacy switches.
Please check: open every tab, add each widget size, and try a favourite.
zh-Hans:
内部测试：快速记账小组件与常用记录。
• 全新快速记账小组件，支持小、中及新增的大尺寸：一个主要操作，其余为带标签的快捷方式。图标改为 − 支出、+ 收入、⇄ 转账、↩ 退款。
• 大尺寸的预算状态与智能概览变为「今日 + 记账」。
• 预算状态显示本月进度标记。
• 记账页新增常用记录：点按即可填入表单，确认后保存。在“已保存”横幅点按星标即可存为常用记录。
• 设置 › 小组件与快捷入口：预览、常用记录与隐私开关。
请检查：打开每个标签页，添加各尺寸小组件，并试用常用记录。
